title: Caldera sunsets and white-washed alleys
shortDescription: 7 nights in a cliffside villa with private pool overlooking the Aegean.
description:
Santorini is a place that doesn't really photograph as well as it deserves. The whitewashed houses cascading down the volcanic caldera, the impossibly blue domes, the sound of donkeys clip-clopping past windmills at sunset — you have to be there.

We put you in a small boutique hotel in Oia, walking distance to the sunset point but tucked far enough away from the cruise-ship crowds. Mornings on your private terrace, afternoons on the black-sand beaches of Perissa, evenings tasting Assyrtiko in family wineries that have been pressing grapes here since before electricity arrived.

The tour includes a sunset catamaran around the caldera, a private guided tour of ancient Akrotiri, and a hands-on cooking class with a local grandmother in her own kitchen.
highlights: Cliffside villa with private plunge pool
Sunset catamaran around the volcanic caldera
Wine tasting in three family wineries
Cooking class with a Santorinian grandmother
Private guide to Akrotiri archaeological site
excluded: Lunches and dinners outside the included activities

program.title: Arrival in paradise
program.text: Land in Santorini, private transfer to Oia. Welcome cocktails on the hotel terrace. Slow first dinner watching the sun melt into the caldera.

program.title: Old town walking tour
program.text: Morning guided walk through Oia's blue-domed alleys. Afternoon free to explore. Sunset point booking included to skip the crowds.

program.title: Catamaran around the caldera
program.text: Full-day private catamaran cruise. Swim stops at the hot springs and the red beach. Sunset BBQ on deck.

program.title: Beach day at Perissa
program.text: Drive to the black-sand beaches on the volcano side. Sunbeds, lunch, and a long siesta. Optional water sports.

program.title: Wine and Assyrtiko
program.text: Visit three family wineries with a sommelier. Lunch at Santo Wines overlooking the caldera.

program.title: Ancient Akrotiri + cooking class
program.text: Morning at the perfectly preserved Bronze Age city. Evening cooking class in a local home — make moussaka, tzatziki, and baklava from scratch.

program.title: Farewell brunch and departure
program.text: Long lazy brunch. Pack up. Private transfer back to the airport.
